name: kernel-filter-containment
description: Reconcile the two independent strong-containment implementations of kernel-filter (feature/containment-v4 vs feature/strong-containment).

acceptance: .\build.cmd succeeds (driver, kfilterctl and probe build with /W4 /WX)
kfilterctl self-test passes and exercises the same matcher the driver uses
Every enforcement layer listed in the objective is implemented, or explicitly documented as not implemented
Documentation does not claim VM, Driver Verifier, signing or anti-cheat compatibility validation that was not performed
base_behavior_invariants: No hooks, injection, anti-cheat bypass, driver hiding or security disabling
Raw disk access and WMI module-load blocking from main (c3ea018, eff419c) are kept
